mood: calm, modern, distinctive, eye-friendly, grounded, professional

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 for cards. Use optical alignment instead of purely geometrical.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.metric_cards: col-span-1. Minimalist flat with 1px border border-[#e5e3db], no shadow. Subtle rounded corners (rounded-xl).
spacing_and_layout.tables: Dense, clean. Remove vertical borders. Subtly tinted header rows (bg-[#f5e8d3]/30).
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed, border-r border-[#e5e3db], light cream bg (#fef8f0) to separate from main canvas.
spacing_and_layout.container: Max width for content blocks should be 7xl for readability.

surface_styles.metric_cards: Flat background (#ffffff), 1px subtle border (#e5e3db), rounded-xl, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-300.
surface_styles.topbar: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#fdfbf7]/70, border-b border-[#e5e3db]/50, sticky z-50.
surface_styles.buttons: Primary: Solid matte deep green (#14532d). Secondary: Muted mustard/terracotta outline or subtle fill. Rounded-lg or rounded-xl.
surface_styles.modals: Solid white background, rounded-2xl, shadow-2xl, max-w-md w-full.

components.tabs: Shadcn tabs, override fixed height to h-auto. Active tab: bg-white shadow-sm rounded-md.
components.forms: Inputs with soft focus rings. Do not use native date inputs, use Shadcn calendar.
components.status_badges: Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Use pale backgrounds with darker text (e.g. pending: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800).

images.description: Minimalist geometric abstract logo mark in forest green and terracotta. Use in sidebar header and login screen.
Abstract architectural background with warm bone-white and soft sage green tones. Use as side hero or full bg on auth page.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle -translate-y-[2px] for cards, brightness reduction for buttons.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade-in with slight upward stagger using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: focus-visible rings on all interactive elements. data-testid attributes mandatory.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. Avoid default Tailwind blues/purples.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Load from Google Fonts.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-btn').
Use Recharts for the dashboards (bar chart for weekly task completion, line chart for sheet submission rate, pie chart for task status). Apply the 'charts' color array.
Use the provided image URLs for logos and avatars. Do NOT use placeholder text or dummyimage.
Structure pages using standard shadcn/ui primitives but customize their Tailwind classes to match the 'surface_styles' defined.
Add 'backdrop-blur-xl' to topbar for the crystal glass effect.
Create generic status badge component applying the colors from 'status' dictionary using soft backgrounds and dark text (e.g. bg-green-100 text-green-800 for done).
Ensure all forms and interactive elements are customized away from the default 'Vercel-look'.
